description:
Quickly upload and download large files — or entire projects — with a single click.

Frame.io Drive is the desktop app for Frame.io, Adobe's video collaboration platform. It mounts Frame.io storage on your desktop, so you can quickly upload and download large files — or entire projects — with a single click.
Mounts and transfers are managed from a single window with a transfer log, downloads keep running in the background while you work, and failed transfers report accurate errors with a downloadable log.
